config.label: Your three
config.description: Your three.ws session token (value of the `__Host-sid` cookie from a signed-in browser). Required for account management operations: create_payment_session, list_payment_sessions, check_payment_session, cancel_payment_session.

config.label: A payment session bearer token (starts with 'pss_') from create_payment_session
config.description: A payment session bearer token (starts with 'pss_') from create_payment_session. Used by the agent for pay_with_session calls when no inline token is passed. Treat like a spending card — it authorizes payments up to the session's budget.

config.label: Base URL of the three
config.description: Base URL of the three.ws API. Override only when self-hosting or targeting a preview deployment.

config.label: Per-request HTTP timeout in milliseconds
config.description: Per-request HTTP timeout in milliseconds. x402 payments involve on-chain settlement so this should be generous (default: 30000).
